name: Beet Salad
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: couple of bunches of chives
ingredients.originalText: a couple of bunches of chives

instructions.text: Boil half a dozen young beets, chop fine and pour over them warm vinegar with a little sugar in it.
Slice very thin a couple of bunches of chives, and chop fine three stalks of celery.
In serving make a foundation of celery leaves, and on it place first the thin slices of chives, then a layer of beets, then chives, and sprinkle over them the chopped celery.
Pour over all a salad dressing.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil half a dozen young beets, chop fine and pour over them warm vinegar with a little sugar in it.
2. Slice very thin a couple of bunches of chives, and chop fine three stalks of celery.
3. In serving make a foundation of celery leaves, and on it place first the thin slices of chives, then a layer of beets, then chives, and sprinkle over them the chopped celery.
4. Pour over all a salad dressing.
